scope: Current-main integration and bounded compatibility checks, retaining original failures/timeout and separate source scopes; original frozen snapshot unchanged.
statement: Integration of main d9ee51f2 preserves both Git merge parents, its exact canonical PCC ledger prefix, all 26 unmerged claim/note bodies, historical branch JSON metadata and reviewed active attestation metadata. Stale locks, SHA-2 LowerHex compilation refusals and the Rust 1.88 requirement of SHA-2 0.11.1 are retained with source scopes. Compatible SHA-2 0.11.0 pins preserve the selected native/wrapper Rust 1.85 floors. On f748c746, native all-target MSRV checks, one digest-vector unit test, three structured CLI/forgery tests, two C arithmetic parity tests, one curve-audit digest test and strict lint/format commands pass; four locked graphs resolve. Source 5b9f7050 separately reports eight auxiliary CLI tests and wrapper all-target MSRV checks passing. The native library attempt on 192a50d6 timed out at 240 seconds and is not passing. Core/auxiliary CLI algorithm bytes remain those of d95d582c. These are unsigned producer controls, not independent execution, full CI qualification or timing improvement.
